title: cordia alliodora
intro: Cordia alliodora, commonly known as Lanatana or Palo Santo, is a tropical flowering plant native to Central and South America, particularly in the Andean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cordia alliodora include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
